pr.title: bench: prepare one matched selective Cells i9 queue job
pr.body:
Prepare the owner-requested three-arm i9 diagnostic as one argument-free PROTOCOL §9 job, `bench-cells-selective-i9`. Existing `ab run` executes 12 balanced rounds × seven pinned corpora × three complete readers (252 decodes); existing Just submission archives success or failure. No decoder changes or workstation measurements.

Common source #380 a8a23c11607864cb431f87fff38169e10c41685f; original arm restores only src/cells.rs from #365 d4f0e8fb3ac68fa649e1810dff58dc06e9c545c2. Segmented and original Cells share one binary; selective uses the matched build. Rust1.100.0, identical release cfg, source/corpus/binary manifests. Automatic pinned corpus generation/reconstruction and read-only i9 topology/affinity preflight; no manual owner paths or CPU choice.

Frozen design: [PLAN](bench/cells-selective-i9/PLAN.md). Coordinator6862425749 accepts the prospective design for preparation, not final READY. PR380 and its historical failed default gate remain unchanged; no safety/default/integration waiver.

Validation at exact cf1a36ed429f361839fab6748383187104d8ab27:
- 22 local untimed tests pass; hosted Test succeeds, including the new real Just recipe/submission test.
- Both native builds complete; all seven compressed hashes match, including freshly generated pinned text and reconstructed Wikidata windows.
- Both builds pass full-byte libbzip2/Segmented/Cells parity, with exactly equal seven route summaries.
- Native1/64MiB self/wait4/proc RSS controls pass; cloud target preflight correctly refuses incompatible AMD/affinity/sysfs facts. Zero measured decodes.
- Actual73,886,771-byte native preparation bundle submitted and idempotently resubmitted to a scratch local Git remote with fake gh; no real GitHub benchmark evidence fabricated. Success/preparation failure/measurement failure wrapper paths also archive and submit exactly once in tests.
- Hosted legacy pre-commit succeeds; macOS x86_64 packaging and ordinary Benchmark remain pending at latest snapshot. The initial Benchmark was superseded automatically on ready-for-review transition, not manually retried to seek a favourable result.

[Durable report and raw native validation](https://github.com/lmmx/mibz2/tree/team-state/codex/state/reports/cells-i9-20261113), including bounded default-path ATTRIBUTION.md: no newly executed default-route source operation identified; codegen/layout causality unresolved, no justified native patch or gate waiver.

NOT READY until exact-head remaining checks pass, Coordinator approves executable, existing Run Signal sets ready at that approved head, and Coordinator admits/verifies the master queue entry. No prior cells-selective-i9 submission exists on evidence01f5bc23ea2242969b084ebff7bf3b178814f3a2. Run Signal transport remains an explicit dependency: neither acting monitor nor Codex connector exposes workflow dispatch. No direct tag bypass. Louis's eventual sole execution command remains `just workstation-queue`.
